source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 2, Properties
source.quote: We also operate three exclusive private destinations which we utilize as ports-of-call on certain itineraries: (i) an island we own in the Bahamas that we call Perfect Day at CocoCay; (ii) Labadee, a secluded peninsula that we lease on the north coast of Haiti; and (iii) Paradise Island, the first Royal Beach Club in the Bahamas, which opened in December 2025.

notes: Workforce from the FY2025 10-K (Dec 31, 2025): approximately 108,000 employees, of which 4,450 shoreside staff are U.S.-based and everyone else (5,450 shoreside, 96,500 shipboard, 1,600 at private destinations) is international, recorded as one region. Country shares are of the shoreside workforce (U.S. 45%, Philippines 37%, Mexico 5%, U.K. 4%). The 10-K also says the shipboard crew comes mostly from the Philippines (34%), Indonesia (17%) and India (16%); that is crew nationality, not where people work, so it is kept out of the rows. The FY2025 10-K describes three operating private destinations (Perfect Day at CocoCay, owned; Labadee, leased; and Royal Beach Club Paradise Island, opened December 2025), all listed as sites. Terminal interests and destinations not yet open at Dec 31, 2025 are left out of sites. Sites re-sourced to the FY2025 10-K. No state data.
